claims.text: The hotel is in Chilean Patagonia, five minutes from Puerto Natales, on the Señoret Channel.

findings.quote: El hotel está ubicado en la Patagonia chilena, a 5 minutos de Puerto Natales y en el canal de Señoret

claims.text: The Singular Patagonia was built on the site of the former Frigorífico Bories, which was declared a National Monument in 1996.

findings.quote: The Singular Patagonia se construyó donde funcionaba el Frigorífico Bories, declarado Monumento Nacional en 1996.

claims.text: The main structures were built as a sheep-processing plant in 1915.

findings.quote: The main structures were built as a sheep-processing plant in 1915

claims.text: In the transition areas of the hotel-museum, the old machinery remains intact and visible.

findings.quote: Y en las áreas de transición de este hotel-museo, la maquinaria de antaño está intactamente visible.

claims.text: The hotel's museum is open to the public and covers the history of Puerto Bories and the old cold-storage plant that gave rise to the hotel.

findings.quote: El Museo de The Singular Patagonia está abierto a todo público y permite conocer parte de la historia de Puerto Bories y del antiguo frigorífico que dio origen al hotel.

claims.text: The hotel offers guests a guided tour of the history of the former cold-storage plant.

findings.quote: Ofrecemos un tour guidado para huépedes, donde podrán sumergirse en la historia que dio origen en 1915 a la Sociedad Explotadora Tierra del Fuego

claims.text: Excursions can start from the hotel to remote places, including Torres del Paine National Park.

findings.quote: lugar desde donde se pueden iniciar excursiones a los lugares más remotos del planeta, incluyendo el Parque Nacional Torres del Paine

claims.text: The hotel sits alone on the waterfront with a dock dating back to the sheep-processing days.

findings.quote: The hotel sits in grand isolation, all alone on the waterfront with a dock dating back to the sheep-processing days.

claims.text: The hotel provides bikes that guests can ride into Puerto Natales.

findings.quote: You can easily ride a bike (provided by the hotel) into Puerto Natales

claims.text: The restaurant menu uses Patagonian ingredients such as guanaco, king crab, rhubarb and austral hake, in a setting overlooking the austral fjords.

findings.quote: Patagonia-sourced ingredients such a guanaco, king crab, rhubarb or austral hake, prepared with classic techniques in a rustic and elegant setting overlooking the breathtaking austral fjords.

claims.text: The Singular Restaurant's cuisine is by Executive Chef Hernán Basso, fusing French trends with locally sourced ingredients.

findings.quote: The Singular Restaurant celebrates the mountain ridges of Seno Última Esperanza, with award-winning cuisine from our Executive Chef, Hernán Basso, fusing French trends with locally sourced ingredients.

claims.text: The pool is indoor/outdoor, letting guests swim under a giant window looking out onto the Sound and out into the open air.

findings.quote: The pool is indoor/outdoor—you can swim under a giant window looking out onto the Sound and be outside in the wind.

claims.text: Rooms feature a wall-sized window looking out onto Última Esperanza Sound, and all rooms have the same view.

findings.quote: with the main feature being a wall-sized window looking out onto Ultima Esperanza Sound
All the rooms have the same view

claims.text: A funicular takes guests down from the brick reception area to the main building.

findings.quote: The exposed pipes in brick reception area and the funicular that take you down to the main building feel steampunk without the whimsy.

claims.text: Excursions offered include a 12-hour trek to the base of the Paine Massif, kayaking on the Sound and a cooking class with the executive chef.

findings.quote: a 12 hour trek to the base of the Paine Massif or kayaking on the Sound or a cooking class with the executive chef

claims.text: The spa's sauna has a view of the Sound.

findings.quote: The spa is also very lovely, and the sauna has the same spectacular view.

claims.text: WhataHotel notes the remote Patagonian location requires significant travel planning.
WhataHotel notes outdoor activities and excursions depend on the weather.
The hotel stands alone on the waterfront outside Puerto Natales, so the town is a bike ride away.

findings.quote: The hotel sits in grand isolation, all alone on the waterfront with a dock dating back to the sheep-processing days.
You can easily ride a bike (provided by the hotel) into Puerto Natales
